newsitem.title: UK: LME zinc, copper keep gains, resistance holds.
newsitem.headline: LME zinc, copper keep gains, resistance holds.

text.p: Zinc prices on the London Metal Exchange on Friday evening held earlier gains but showed no inclination to break through resistance levels.

Traders said the market had risen earlier on the possibility of a squeeze in September but the momentum began to stall at $1,495 just short of the $1,500 target which would have signalled a continuing rally.
At 1800 GMT zinc was indicated at $1,486/$1,489 around the kerb close.
Copper was also around kerb levels at $2,284/$2,288 and aluminium was barely changed at $1,580/$1,583.
